newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Three Germans killed in light plane crash - agency.
newsitem.headline: Three Germans killed in light plane crash - agency.

text.p: Three German citizens were killed and one was seriously injured when a light aircraft on a pleasure flight crashed near the southwest Czech town of Prachatice, the news agency CTK reported on Tuesday.
CTK said the injured person suffered serious burns, but it did not give any further details. It did not say whether there were any other passnegers.
Prachatice lies about 25 km (16 miles) from the Czech-German border, in the scenic Bohemian forest.
